card.name: Word-start letters j and P
card.fires_on: A word-initial letter or short piece, mostly "j" or "P", that starts a longer word such as jarring, jingoism, jargon, jolts, jocks, or Pacifism. It is most often seen in general web prose.

modes.label: Lowercase j starts
modes.description: A lone "j" begins a word that continues in the next piece, such as jarring, jingoism, jargon or jolts.

modes.label: Capital P starts
modes.description: A capital P or Pac begins a word, often in all-caps text or after a heading.
modes.example: REPORTS HAVE CITED<< P>>ULMONARY REACTIONS AS A
